question: Three fair coins are tossed simultaneously. A random variable $X$ is defined as the number of heads obtained minus the number of tails obtained. Determine (a) all possible values of $X$ and its probability distribution and (b) $P(|X|=1)$.
explanation:
(a)
The sample space consists of $8$ equally likely outcomes. If no head occurs, then there are three tails and $X=0-3=-3$. If exactly one head occurs, then there are two tails and $X=1-2=-1$. If exactly two heads occur, then there is one tail and $X=2-1=1$. If three heads occur, then $X=3-0=3$. Thus the possible values are
$$-3,-1,1,3.$$
There is $1$ outcome with no head, $3$ outcomes with exactly one head, $3$ outcomes with exactly two heads and $1$ outcome with three heads. Therefore the probability distribution is
$$X:-3,-1,1,3$$
$$P(X):\frac{1}{8},\frac{3}{8},\frac{3}{8},\frac{1}{8}.$$
The probabilities are all non-negative and their sum is
$$\frac{1}{8}+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{1}{8}=1,$$
so this is a valid probability distribution.

(b)
The event $|X|=1$ occurs when $X=-1$ or $X=1$. Hence,
$$P(|X|=1)=P(X=-1)+P(X=1)=\frac{3}{8}+\frac{3}{8}=\frac{3}{4}.$$

Final Result
The possible values of $X$ are $-3,-1,1,3$ with the distribution shown above, and $P(|X|=1)=\frac{3}{4}$.
